svg.title: Adding and removing zones with the keyboard in Zonogy. A shortcut adds a zone, which opens empty, with the Launcher in it. Minimizing a window leaves its zone in place, empty, with the Launcher open; minimizing again removes the zone.
svg.text: Add a zone: it opens empty, with the Launcher in it
Minimize a window: its zone stays, with the Launcher open
Minimize again to remove the zone
